class.name: HTMLFocusEvent
class.description: [code]focus[/code] and [code]blur[/code] do not bubble. [code]focusin[/code] and [code]focusout[/code] report the same transitions and bubble, which makes them suitable for delegation. When focus moves between elements, the outgoing events run before the incoming ones.

members.member: The node that gains focus for [code]blur[/code] and [code]focusout[/code], or the node that loses it for [code]focus[/code] and [code]focusin[/code]. It is [code]null[/code] when focus enters or leaves the document.
